mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super available from the TP Medal Shop. The user punches forward to create an energy burst; an uncharged release hits once for a source-reported 10% damage, while holding the input produces up to three projectiles for a source-reported 15% total and increases range. Current evidence also records CaC usability after Supreme Kai of Time content; exact charge timing and scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
